grading_system.evidence: Minimum of 24 credits are required for graduation.

schedule.evidence: Bellows Free Academy's school year is divided into two semesters of approximately 88 days each. BFA's schedule has seven periods, three days a week, for 45 minutes. Two days a week, students have each period once for 80 minutes.

credit_definition.text: Credit is awarded at the end of each course, one-half credit per semester and one credit per year-long course.
credit_definition.evidence: Credit is awarded at the end of each course, one-half credit per semester and one credit per year-long course.

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: at least five academic classes to be full-time (for athletics and honors eligibility)
course_load.evidence: To be considered a full-time student—and to remain eligible for athletics and honors—students must be enrolled in at least five academic classes.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Credits as stated (one credit = year-long course; .5 = semester course); no conversion needed. Also requires 10 hours of approved senior community service (p.5) and a PLP each year.

flexible_pathways_listed: flexible pathways elective or content-area credit
notes: Minimum credit count is stated (24, p.6), and the English and Math sections label their requirements 'Proficiency-Based Graduation Requirements' (English p.13; Math p.19); Vermont Transferable Skills are required at Basic Proficiency (p.5). Hence hybrid, but the proficiency scale and credit threshold are not stated. Credit-area minimums (p.5): English 4, Math 3, Science 3, Social Studies 3, Personal Finance 0.5, Fine Arts 1, Health 0.5, PE 1.5, Electives 7.5. Schedule: seven periods on a three-day/two-day pattern (rotating); students carry seven classes per semester (p.4). Promotion requires 5 credits (to grade 10), 11 (to 11), 17 (to 12). Required PLP each year and a PBL course in grade 11 or 12 (p.5).
